verdict.rationale: Mangopay publishes AI-agent enablement infrastructure — an llms.txt with explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents', a build-with-ai.md guide, machine-readable Markdown/OpenAPI docs, and a documented MCP server endpoint — which lets AI agents translate natural-language requests into API calls. However, there's no evidence of an actual natural-language command interface, chat UI, or hands-on demonstration of a user issuing NL commands against the product itself. Missing for 10: a demonstrated NL command interface/chat experience, independent corroboration of the MCP server working end-to-end, and evidence of non-developer natural-language operation rather than just agent/API tooling.
